title: cli: llms_txt_validator uses different exit codes than doc_transformer
description:
# Bug: Exit Code Inconsistency Between Commands

## Severity
P0 - MAJOR

## Description
The llms_txt_validator binary uses different exit codes than doc_transformer:

llms_txt_validator:
- Exit 0: Success
- Exit 1: Validation failed
- Exit 4: JSON parse error  
- Exit 5: File not found

doc_transformer:
- Exit 0: Success
- Exit 1: User error (bad arguments, missing files, invalid URL)
- Exit 2: Pipeline error

This violates the Cross-Command Consistency attack category.

## Reproduction Steps
1. Run: `./llms_txt_validator /nonexistent/file.txt` → Exit 5
2. Run: `./doc_transformer index /nonexistent --output /tmp/out` → Exit 1

Same error type (file not found) but different exit codes.

## Fix Required
Standardize exit codes across all binaries in the project.
close_reason: Fixed: standardized exit codes - 0=success, 1=user error, 2=pipeline error
